review: The nine-element parse buffer is zero-initialized; parsed values are consumed only when sscanf reports all nine conversions.
Trigger range is validated before subtracting one, so record selection stays within the three 13-byte records.
Sequence values are checked before narrowing the record fields to bytes.
The stock callback reports count even on parse or validation failure; this behavior is preserved.
The record is updated before mutex_lock in the stock instruction order; hardware calls alone are inside the mutex.
limitations: Static review cannot establish concurrent hardware behavior or the intended user-space ABI beyond the stock evidence.
